contexts.text: Women who... have entirely given themselves up to... a delicate and idle life... (Their lot.)
They who have lived in pleasures, or in a delicate life conjoined with interior cunning, are under the heel of the right foot... SE 2773.
Man may eat and drink delicately, provided he does not make his life to consist in it.
They who have... lived delicately, and indulged their appetite, loving these things as the highest goods of life, in the other life love excrements and privies...
Clusters... some of which were of a delicate flavour... CL 8.
On the punishment of women especially, who lead a delicate and idle life.
Such are they who care too much about the cuticle... who are otherwise called the delicate...
Their Subject could put forth an idea of herself... as of a Queen... leaning on the arm of a throne, as delicate females are wont to do.
